# Indian Space Hub Store — Official Merchandise Platform

> **Indian Space Hub Tagline**: The New Era of Indian Space  
> **Merchandise Tagline**: Wear India's Space Story.

## Overview
Indian Space Hub Store (`shop.indianspacehub.com`) offers authentic ISRO-inspired space merchandise, apparel (sweatshirts, hoodies, t-shirts), telescopes, scale model rockets (Gaganyaan, Chandrayaan, LVM3/GSLV Mk III), and space toys. The platform operates on a community-driven interest threshold system: users register interest for upcoming drops with mandatory name, email, and phone number. Production & shipping unlock once a minimum pre-registration target is reached.

## Domain & System Architecture
- Primary Store Domain: https://shop.indianspacehub.com
- Main Platform: https://indianspacehub.com
- Target Audience: Space enthusiasts, astronomy lovers, ISRO mission fans in India & worldwide.
- Currency: Indian Rupee (INR / ₹)
- Official Support Email: crew@indianspacehub.com

## Social Channels
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/isro.unoffical
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/isro-indian-space-hub/

## Core Offerings
- **ISRO Mission Apparel**: Sweatshirts, oversized t-shirts, and limited edition hoodies celebrating Gaganyaan, Chandrayaan, and Aditya-L1 missions.
- **Scale Model Rockets**: Authentic 1:100 and 1:200 scale models of ISRO launch vehicles (LVM3, PSLV, SSLV).
- **Astronomy Equipment**: Beginner & enthusiast refractor/reflector telescopes.
- **Collectibles & Toys**: Space patches, mission badges, space station models, and educational toys.

## How Interest Registration Works
1. Visitors browse active merchandise drops on `shop.indianspacehub.com`.
2. Product cards show live goal progress (e.g. 38/50 interest votes).
3. Users click "Express Interest" to select a size and register mandatory name, email address, and phone/WhatsApp number.
4. When `min_interest_required` target is reached, pre-order & shipping unlock and registered users receive notification emails & SMS updates.
